name: qlrisk_price_overnight_index_swap
title: Price a OvernightIndexSwap
description: Price one qlrisk OvernightIndexSwap (Overnight Index Swap - floating leg tied to overnight rate; interest_rate, interest_rate): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: notional, fixed_rate (maturity_date or tenor_years). Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"notional": 1000000, "tenor_years": 5, "fixed_rate": 0.04}.
